.then(function(d){\n            if (d.code === 0) {\n                ncUpdateRatingUI(d.ratings);\n                if (d.your_vote) ncMarkVoted(d.your_vote);\n            }\n        }).catch(function(){});\n}\n\nfunction ncUpdateRatingUI(ratings) {\n    ncEmojis.forEach(function(e, i) {\n        var el = document.getElementById('nc-cnt-' + i);\n        if (el) el.textContent = if (confirmEl) confirmEl.style.display = 'none';\n    var msg = document.getElementById('nc-rating-msg');\n    if (msg && !msg.textContent) {\n        msg.style.color = '#27ae60';\n        msg.textContent = '你已為本書評分，無法再次修改';\n    }\n}\n\nvar ncSelectedEmoji = null;\n\nfunction ncSelect(emoji) {\n    if (document.querySelector('.nc-emoji-btn[disabled]')) return;\n    ncSelectedEmoji = (confirmText) { confirmText.textContent = '確定選擇 ' + emoji + ' 嗎？提交後無法修改'; }\n}\n\nfunction ncCancelSelect() {\n    ncSelectedEmoji = null;\n    document.querySelectorAll('.nc-emoji-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('nc-active'); });\n    var confirmEl = document.getElementById('nc-rating-confirm');\n    if (confirmEl)   fd.append('article_id', ncArticleId);\n    fd.append('emoji', emoji);\n    fetch('/api/novel_comment.php', { method: 'POST', body: fd })\n        .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })\n        .then(function(d){\n            var msg = document.getElementById('nc-rating-msg');\n            if (d.code === 0) {\n                ncUpdateRatingUI(d.ratings);\n                msg.style.color =                msg.textContent = d.msg || '評分失敗，請稍後再試';\n                if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.disabled = false; confirmBtn.textContent = '確定送出'; }\n            }\n        }).catch(function(){\n            var msg = document.getElementById('nc-rating-msg');\n            msg.style.color = '#e74c3c';\n            msg.textContent = '網路錯誤，請稍後再試';\n            if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.disabled = false; confirmBtn.textContent = '確定送出'; }\n        });\n}\n\nfunction ncRenderComments(comments, list) {\n    if (!comments || !comments.length) {\n        list.innerHTML = '<div class=\"nc-empty\">還沒有評論，快來搶沙發吧！</div>';\n        return;\n    }\n\n    var topLevel = [], commentById = {}, ancestorMap = {};\n    comments.forEach(function(c){ commentById[c.id] = c; });\n    comments.forEach(function(c){\n        if (!c.reply_to_id) { topLevel.push(c); }\n    });\n\n\n    function getTopAncestorId(c, depth) {\n        if (depth > 20) return null;\n        if (!c.reply_to_id) return c.id;\n        var parent = commentById[c.reply_to_id];\n        if (!parent) return null;\n        return getTopAncestorId(parent, depth + 1);\n    }\n\n\n    comments.forEach(function(c){\n        if (!c.reply_to_id) return;\n        var aid = getTopAncestorId(c, 0);\n        if (aid !== null) {\n            if (!ancestorMap[aid]) ancestorMap[aid] = [];\n            ancestorMap[aid].push(c);\n        }\n    });\n\n    function renderTopComment(c) {\n        var av = c.avatar\n            ? '<img class=\"nc-comment-avatar\" src=\"' + c.avatar + '\" alt=\"' + c.nickname + '\">'\n            : '<div class=\"nc-comment-avatar-ph\">' + (c.nickname.charAt(0)||'匿') + '</div>';\n        var vipBadge = c.is_vip ? '<span class=\"nc-vip-badge\">👑 VIP</span>' : '';\n        var replyBtn = ncIsLogin ? '<button class=\"nc-reply-btn\" data-id=\"' + c.id + '\" data-nick=\"' + c.nickname + '\">回覆</button>' : '';\n        var voteRow  = '<div class=\"nc-vote-row\">'\n            + '<button class=\"nc-vote-btn' + (c.my_vote===1?' nc-liked':'') + '\" data-cid=\"' + c.id + '\" data-type=\"1\">👍 <span>' + (c.like_count||0) + '</span></button>'\n            + '<button class=\"nc-vote-btn' + (c.my_vote===-1?' nc-disliked':'') + '\" data-cid=\"' + c.id + '\" data-type=\"-1\">👎 <span>' + (c.dislike_count||0) + '</span></button>'\n            + '</div>';\n        return '<div class=\"nc-comment-item\" data-cid=\"' + c.id + '\">' + av\n            + '<div class=\"nc-comment-body\">'\n            + '<div class=\"nc-comment-meta\"><span class=\"nc-comment-nick\">' + c.nickname + '</span>' + vipBadge + '<span>' + c.time + '</span>' + replyBtn + '</div>'\n            + '<div class=\"nc-comment-text\">' + c.content + '</div>'\n            + voteRow\n            + '</div></div>';\n    }\n\n    function renderNestedReply(r) {\n        var av = r.avatar\n            ? '<img style=\"width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0\" src=\"' + r.avatar + '\" alt=\"' + r.nickname + '\">'\n            : '<div style=\"width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:#e74c3c;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0\">' + (r.nickname.charAt(0)||'匿') + '</div>';\n        var vipBadge = r.is_vip ? nc-liked':'') + '\" data-cid=\"' + r.id + '\" data-type=\"1\">👍 <span>' + (r.like_count||0) + '</span></button>'\n            + '<button class=\"nc-vote-btn' + (r.my_vote===-1?' nc-disliked':'') + '\" + replyBtn + '</div>'\n            + '<div class=\"nc-comment-text\">' + replyRef + r.content + '</div>'\n            + voteRow\n            + '</div></div>';\n    }\n\n    var html = '';\n\n    topLevel.forEach(function(c){\n        html += renderTopComment(c);\n        if (ancestorMap[c.id]) {\n            ancestorMap[c.id].slice().reverse().forEach(function(r){\n                html += renderNestedReply(r);\n            });\n        }\n    });\n\n    comments.forEach(function(c){\n        if (!c.reply_to_id) return;\n        if (getTopAncestorId(c, 0) === null) {\n            html += renderTopComment(c);\n        }\n    });\n    list.innerHTML = html;\n}\n\nfunction ncLoadComments(cb) {\n    var list = document.getElementById('nc-comment-list');\n    list.innerHTML = '<div (d.code !== 0) {\n                list.innerHTML = '<div class=\"nc-empty\">載入失敗，請稍後重試</div>';\n                if (typeof cb === 'function') cb([]);\n                return;\n            }\n            var comments = d.comments || [];\n            ncRenderComments(comments, list);\n            if (typeof cb === 'function') cb(comments);\n        }).catch(function(){\n            list.innerHTML = '<div class=\"nc-empty\">載入失敗，請稍後重試</div>';\n            if (typeof cb === 'function') cb([]);\n        });\n}\n\n\nncLoadRatings();\n\nvar ncCommentsLoaded = false;\nfunction ncTriggerLoad() {\n    if (ncCommentsLoaded) return;\n    ncCommentsLoaded = true;\n    var btnWrap = document.getElementById('nc-load-btn-wrap');\n    if (btnWrap) btnWrap.style.display = 'none';\n    var list = document.getElementById('nc-comment-list');\n    list.innerHTML = '<div class=\"nc-loading\">載入中...</div>';\n    var cacheKey = 'nc_c_' + ncArticleId;\n    try {\n        var cached = sessionStorage.getItem(cacheKey);\n        if (cached) {\n            ncRenderComments(JSON.parse(cached), list);\n            return;\n        }\n    } catch(e) { sessionStorage.removeItem(cacheKey); }\n    ncLoadComments(function(comments) {\n        try { sessionStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(comments)); } catch(e) {}\n    });\n}\n\n\nvar ncMainWidgetId  = null;\nvar ncMainAutoSubmit = false;\n\nfunction ncRefreshCaptcha() {\n    if (ncMainWidgetId !== null && typeof turnstile !== 'undefined') turnstile.reset(ncMainWidgetId);\n}\n\nfunction ncSubmit() {\n    var content = document.getElementById('nc-content').value.trim();\n    var msgEl   = document.getElementById('nc-form-msg');\n\n    if (!content) { msgEl.style.color='#e74c3c'; msgEl.textContent='請輸入評論內容'; return;        ncMainAutoSubmit = true;\n            ncMainWidgetId = turnstile.render(tsWrap, {\n                sitekey: '0x4AAAAAACf1NZiKIzzSvFR_',\n                theme: 'light',\n                callback: function() {\n                    if (ncMainAutoSubmit) { ncMainAutoSubmit = false; ncSubmit(); }\n                }\n            });\n        }\n        msgEl.style.color = '#888';\n        msgEl.textContent = '請等待人機驗證完成';\n        return;\n    }\n\n    var tsInput = document.querySelector('#nc-main-turnstile [name=\"cf-turnstile-response\"]');\n    var cfToken = tsInput ? tsInput.value
